name: Liveness Probe Missing Health File
expected_symptoms: Liveness probe failed: cat: can't open '/tmp/healthy': No such file or directory
Container also exits on its own after 5 seconds
root_cause: The liveness probe checks for /tmp/healthy using 'cat', but this file is never created. Additionally, the container command exits after 5 seconds. Both issues cause the pod to restart continuously.
fix_steps: Fix the container command to run a long-lived process and create the health file: command: ['sh', '-c', 'touch /tmp/healthy && sleep 3600']
